data.title: 美狄亚 · 魔术师的海滨玻璃瓶
data.description: 【希腊风海湾·午后】美狄亚穿着紫蓝色泳装与轻便罩衫，坐在潮池旁把贝壳、海玻璃和海水装进小瓶；瓶中映出一枚微光魔法阵，她抬眼朝镜头微笑，像把海边的宁静也封存了。
data.action: 潮池旁把贝壳海玻璃装入小瓶，微光魔法阵映出整片海湾
data.lighting: soft afternoon light on clear tide pools
data.mood: 把假日变成精密小魔术
data.promptProse: Medea sits beside the tide pool and arranges shells and sea glass inside a small clear bottle, looking up with quiet satisfaction. Her violet-blue wrap swimsuit, light hooded cover-up and shell bracelets remain in the horizontal medium view. A faint magic circle in the pool suggests the preserved cove. Soft afternoon light shines through the bottle and shallow water, while the circle's local glow outlines submerged shells against the shaded rock basin.
